preconditions.description: The length of the input string S is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'a-z' for c in S)
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string S are lowercase alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: output == min(add_chars for add_chars in range(len(S) + 1) if is_palindrome(S[:add_chars] + S))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of characters that need to be added to the front of the string S to make it a palindrome.
